description.value: Sooke Hills Wilderness Regional Park is a large nature reserve managed by the Capital Regional District on southern Vancouver Island near Sooke. It offers a wilderness experience within reach of Greater Victoria, making it a worthwhile detour for touring cyclists exploring the region. The park sits in rugged forested terrain and provides a contrast to the more developed areas along the coast.
